quarterly_data.signal: Ichor's 10-Q: cash used in investing activities, consisting of capital expenditures, was $14.8 million in the six months ended June 26, 2026 versus $25.8 million a year earlier, the decrease primarily due to reduced capital expenditures in Malaysia and Mexico as planned capacity expansions approach completion. The 10-Q compares second-quarter 2026 net sales with $240.3 million in the same period of the prior year.
